About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell’s Supply Chain Master Data (SCMD) team is a newly established global function that safeguards the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of the master data powering supply chain planning and execution across parts, BOMs, manufacturing flows, planning and engineering parameters, and resource records.

In Marvell’s fabless semiconductor model, high-quality master data is critical to seamless execution across foundry, OSAT, test, hub, and customer operations. SCMD enables reliable planning, reduces operational risk, and helps prevent NPI delays, planning disruptions, and customer escalations.

What You Can Expect

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.
• 10+ years of experience in semiconductor supply chain operations, master data management, NPI planning, supply chain & capacity planning, or supply chain data governance.
• Strong understanding of fabless semiconductor manufacturing flows and related master data across foundry, OSAT, assembly, test, and hub operations.
• Experience with supplier/site governance, Capacity Planning master data, PCN qualification, B2B integration, yield data management, and Plan vs. Actual operating reviews.
• Strong data governance experience, including defining data standards, ownership models, stewardship processes, validation controls, approval workflows, and governance routines that ensure reliable master data across systems and business functions.
• Strong leadership and influence skills, with the ability to drive alignment across engineering, operations, and supplier organizations.
• Strong analytical and data management skills, including experience with planning systems, WIP/Inventory data, and driving data accuracy across systems.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel and familiarity with data analytics tools; experience with forecasting and planning models is highly desirable.
• Experience with ERP systems (Oracle preferred), Planning Systems (Kinaxis preferred) and supply chain dashboards for data quality tracking and reporting.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex data and present clear, actionable insights to senior leadership and cross-functional teams.

What We're Looking For

This role offers an opportunity to help build a foundational SCMD capability for Marvell. The position owns product and supply planning master data across the full lifecycle—from item and BOM creation in Agile PLM and Oracle ERP synchronization to capacity, planning parameters, supplier governance, B2B integration quality, and yield data stewardship—while partnering with NPI, engineering, planning, procurement, and IT teams to enable reliable planning and flawless manufacturing execution.

Product Master Data Process

• Manage the overall process for item, BOM, and routing setup from prototype through EOL across Agile PLM and Oracle ERP.
• Drive change-control process discipline for BOM revisions from NPI through production.
• Drive process improvements for BOM, part setup, AVL, routing, and planning parameters
• Coordinate with Supply Chain Planning and NPI planning to finalize First-of-a-kind BOM/routing changes and institutionalize reusable, repeatable processes.
• Improve change-order tracking processes to close gaps and reduce cycle time.

Supply Chain Planning Parameters & Capacity Data

• Own the process of managing planning parameters (allocation splits, time-phased preferences, loading rules) across ERP and planning systems.
• Lead the process transformation from spreadsheet-based tracking to scalable, system-integrated global single source of capacity data
• Own the process for maintaining lead time and engineering inputs including purchasing lead times, cycle times, GDPW, assembly/test yield, bin distribution.
• Lead Plan vs. Actual review processes to identify and correct gaps between planning and current operational performance.
• Ensure zero defects in planning parameters and capacity data through robust process and ongoing validation

Data Quality & Governance Process Improvement

• Monitor KPIs across parts, BOMs, PLM-ERP sync, capacity, lead time, B2B integration, and planning parameters.
• Lead root-cause analysis and build upstream process controls that prevent recurring data quality issues.
• Drive process standardization across naming, lifecycle states, duplicates, and stale data to mature governance.
• Own the gate-readiness check process across NPI milestones: POR, TO, 1st Silicon, ES, Qual, PR, and MPR.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW:

The Health Outcomes and Health Technology Assessment team (HOHTA) is the UK team accountable for gaining national access for our medicines at launch via Health Technology Assessment submissions to NICE, SMC, AWMSG etc. We are a part of the Pricing, Reimbursement & Access (PRA) function which covers the Northern European Hub (UK and Ireland plus Nordic countries) and includes a field-based team.

Accountable for developing the health economic strategy and delivering Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions to gain national access for Lilly medicines in the UK and Ireland (and providing support across the Northern European Hub).

• Develop UK health economic and HTA strategies for Lilly medicines and line extensions.
• Lead all aspects of the dossier development and submission process for NICE, Scottish Medicines Consortium, All Wales Medicines Strategy Group, National Centre of Pharmacoeconomics and other health technology assessment groups.
• Select, manage, and support relevant market access agencies (UK) to prepare and write HTA submissions and ensure the delivery of quality outputs.
• Provide support and guidance to colleagues across the NE Hub in their HTA submissions
• Partner with the International Value & Access (IVA) function in the development and review of health economic models and associated deliverables (model reports, SLRs, NMAs etc) to ensure they are suitable for the UK HTA environment.
• Represent the Lilly health economic case responding to queries at NICE and SMC appraisal meetings.
• Review and monitor competitor/comparator HTA submissions for key insights, also collaborating with Marketing/Brand teams, Medical and Real-World Evidence.

• Provide technical and strategic input into the early phase development of Lilly medicines via shallow and deep dives.
• Ensure horizon scanning platforms are kept up-to-date with Lilly pipeline medicines

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Post-graduate Masters Degree in Health Economics (or including strong health economics element).
• Knowledge of all technical aspects of health economic evaluation, including methods of cost effectiveness analysis and assessment of patient quality of life and functional status, as well as the ability to apply health economics principles to practical issues.
• Previous experience contributing or leading NICE, SMC or similar submissions

• Highly proficient in Microsoft applications especially Excel
• AI literate and solution-oriented mindset
• Able to lead without authority and comfortable to work autonomously
• Knowledge of NHS/ local payer environment and private market ecosystems
• Self-starter with the ability to think outside the box to provide innovative solutions
• Experience of multiple therapy areas
